people.name: Walt
lines: Set all three rail-yard signal levers in order — north siding, mid track, then east switch.
Once the iron arms click together, the Last Departure bell still rings.

people.name: Ada
lines: Columbus Circle still gathers every road from Massachusetts Ave to Capitol Hill.

people.name: Miles
lines: We kept the ticket annex and parcel room dry for travelers coming off the rails.

people.name: Ruth
lines: Magnemite and Voltorb hum along the iron rails whenever a storm builds.

signs.text: Union Station — vaulted concourse silent beneath the stone arches.
Columbus Circle — curved stone forecourt and dry fountain basin.
West Ticket Annex — yellowed departure boards still hung on brass hooks.
Express Parcel Room — hand trucks parked neat beside the dock.
West Postal Arcade — sandstone pillars flanking Columbus Circle.
East Express Arcade — brass mail chutes bolted against the fog.
H Street Row — trainmen's bunkhouse and counter room facing the circle.
Track Atlas Office — iron-bound rail timetables kept dry inside.
Switchman's Row — brick cottages south of Columbus Plaza.
Railhead Supply Post — lantern oil and spare switches stored inside.
F Street Crossing — avenue south toward Upper Senate Park.
South Concourse Walk — brick rowhouse avenue linking F and E Streets.
Massachusetts Avenue Gate — road west along Embassy Row to Dupont Circle.
Union Station Rail Yard
Signal Lever I (North Siding) — rusted iron switch arm set for Track 1.
Signal Lever II (Mid Siding) — brass indicator plate marked Last Departure.
Signal Lever III (South Siding) — heavy counterweighted throw linking to the concourse.
Upper Senate Gate — avenue south toward Capitol Hill.
Massachusetts Avenue West — grand road toward Mount Vernon Square.
North Railhead Steps — granite stair overlooking all three freight sidings.
West Freight Yard — iron switch boxes half-buried in clover.
East Signal Gantry — steel truss rusted silent over Track 3.
Lower H Street — brick freight houses bordering the south fog.
South Concourse Alley — cobblestones ringing the lower rail quarter.
North Coal Trestle — mossy masonry framing the yard siding.
East Baggage Spur — iron buffer stop rusted at the end of Track 2.
West Switch Tower — weathered brick shed beside the north siding.
